rows.text_en: Ministry of Science and ICT ( Korea Post Infrastructure Planning Division ), 044-200-8185, 8188
Chapter 1 Notification of Designation Termination and Cancellation

rows.source_ko: 제1조(별정우체국설치예정지등의 고시) 지방우정청장은 「별정우체국법 시행령」 제3조에 따라 별정우체국설치예정지를 고시하는 경우에는 그 설치예정지와 1월이상의 별정우체국지정신청접수기간을 정하여 관보에 이를 고시하여야 한다. <개정 1998. 12. 31., 2002. 3. 9., 2005. 6. 20., 2014. 9. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Notice of Planned Location for Establishment of Special Post Office, etc.) In cases where the Director of a Regional Postal Service notifies a planned location for the establishment of a special post office pursuant to Article 3 of the Enforcement Decree of the Special Post Office Act, he/she shall determine the planned location and a period of at least one month for receiving applications for designation as a special post office, and publish such information in the Official Gazette. <Amended Dec. 31, 1998; Mar. 9, 2002; Jun. 20, 2005; Sep. 2, 2014>
[Wholly Amended July 3, 1982]

rows.source_ko: 제2조(지정신청서 및 첨부서류) ①별정우체국의 지정을 받으려는 사람은 별지 제1호서식에 의한 별정우체국지정신청서(전자문서로 된 신청서를 포함한다)에 다음 각 호의 서류(전자문서를 포함한다)를 첨부하여 관할지방우정청장에게 제출해야 한다. <개정 1987. 5. 21., 1993. 5. 1., 1998. 12. 31., 2002. 3. 9., 2004. 7. 6., 2005. 6. 20., 2006. 7. 19., 2009. 12. 31., 2014. 9. 2., 2025. 12. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Application for Designation and Attached Documents) ① A person who intends to be designated as a Special Post Office shall submit an Application for Designation of a Special Post Office in accordance with Attached Form No. 1 (including an application in the form of an electronic document) to the Director of the competent Regional Postal Service, attaching the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs (including electronic documents). <Amended May 21, 1987; May 1, 1993; December 31, 1998; March 9, 2002; July 6, 2004; June 20, 2005; July 19, 2006; December 31, 2009; September 2, 2014; December 1, 2025>
1. Deleted <March 9, 2002>

rows.source_ko: 2. 「건강검진기본법」 제14조에 따라 지정된 검진기관에서 발급한 신체검사서 또는 국민건강보험공단이 「국민건강보험법」 제52조제2항제1호에 따른 일반건강검진 결과를 활용하여 신체검사를 대체할 목적으로 발급한 서류
rows.text_en: 2. A physical examination certificate issued by an examination institution designated pursuant to Article 14 of the Framework Act on Health Examinations , or a document issued by the National Health Insurance Service for the purpose of substituting a physical examination using the results of a general health examination pursuant to Article 52, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 1 of the National Health Insurance Act.
3. Documents regarding office building facilities
a. When using the existing building

rows.source_ko: 청사로 사용할 건물을 사용할 수 있는 권리를 증명하는 서류
rows.text_en: Documents proving the right to use a building to be used as an office
B. When constructing a new building
Location map of the planned construction site, urban planning confirmation certificate, and site certification
4. Building plans and facility plans
5. Letter of Guarantee
6. Deleted <July 19, 2006>

rows.source_ko: 7. 제3조제1항의 부동산에 대하여 「감정평가 및 감정평가사에 관한 법률」에 따른 감정평가사 또는 감정평가법인이 발급한 감정평가서
rows.text_en: 7. An appraisal report issued by an appraiser or an appraisal firm pursuant to the Act on Appraisal and Appraisers for the real estate referred to in Article 3, Paragraph 1

rows.source_ko: 8. 신원보증인의 주민등록증 등 공공기관이 발행한 본인 확인이 가능한 신분증 사본
rows.text_en: 8. A copy of the guarantor's identification card issued by a public institution capable of verifying identity, such as a Resident Registration Card.
9. Deleted <May 21, 1987>

rows.source_ko: ②제1항에 따라 지정신청서를 제출받은 담당공무원은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 부동산등기부등본(신원보증인의 부동산등기부등본을 포함한다)을 확인하여야 한다. <신설 2006. 7. 19., 2010. 6. 29.>
rows.text_en: ② The public official in charge who receives the application for designation pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall verify the certified copy of the real estate register (including the certified copy of the real estate register of the guarantor) through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act. <Newly added July 19, 2006; June 29, 2010>

rows.source_ko: ③관할지방우정청장은 별정우체국의 지정을 하기 전에 신청인에 대한 신원조회를 실시하여야 한다. <신설 2002. 3. 9., 2006. 7. 19., 2014. 9. 2.>
rows.text_en: ③ The head of the competent Regional Postal Service shall conduct a background check on the applicant before designating a Special Post Office. <Newly added Mar. 9, 2002; July 19, 2006; Sep. 2, 2014>
[Wholly Amended Sep. 12, 1980]

rows.source_ko: 제3조(신청인 등의 자산) ①「별정우체국법」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제3조의2제4호 및 제5호와 법 제5조제5호 및 제6호에서 “과학기술정보통신부령으로 정하는 자산이 있는 사람”이란 「지방세법」에 따른 부동산의 과세 시가표준액이 1천만원 이상인 부동산을 소유하고 있는 사람을 말한다. <개정 1987. 5. 21., 1993. 5. 1., 1998. 12. 31., 2002. 3. 9., 2005. 6. 20., 2008. 3. 3., 2013. 3. 24., 2017. 7. 26., 2025. 12. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Assets of Applicants, etc.) ① In Article 3-2, subparagraphs 4 and 5 of the Special Post Office Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) and Article 5 , subparagraphs 5 and 6 of the Act , the term “person having assets prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Science and ICT” refers to a person who owns real estate whose standard assessed value under the Local Tax Act is 10 million won or more. <Amended May 21, 1987; May 1, 1993; December 31, 1998; March 9, 2002; June 20, 2005; March 3, 2008; March 24, 2013; July 26, 2017; December 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ②법 제3조의2제5호 및 제5조제6호에서 “과학기술정보통신부령으로 정하는 금액”이라 함은 8천만원을 말한다. <신설 2002. 3. 9., 2008. 3. 3., 2013. 3. 24., 2014. 9. 2., 2017. 7. 26.>
rows.text_en: ② In Article 3-2, subparagraph 5 and Article 5 , subparagraph 6 of the Act , the term “amount prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Science and ICT” refers to 80 million won. <Newly added Mar. 9, 2002; Mar. 3, 2008; Mar. 24, 2013; Sep. 2, 2014; Jul. 26, 2017>

[Wholly Amended July 3, 1982]
[Title Amended March 9, 2002]

rows.source_ko: 제4조(실사조서의 작성) 지방우정청장은 별정우체국지정신청서류를 접수하였을 때에는 그 신청내용을 조사하고 별지 제2호서식에 의한 실사조서를 작성하여야 한다. <개정 1998. 12. 31., 2002. 3. 9., 2014. 9. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Preparation of On-site Inspection Report) When the Director of a Regional Postal Service receives documents for the designation of a Special Post Office, he/she shall investigate the contents of the application and prepare an on-site inspection report in accordance with Attached Form No. 2. <Amended Dec. 31, 1998; Mar. 9, 2002; Sep. 2, 2014>

rows.source_ko: 제5조(지정서의 발부) ①지방우정청장은 별정우체국의 지정을 하는 때에는 별지 제3호서식에 의한 별정우체국지정서를 신청인에게 교부한다. <개정 1998. 12. 31., 2002. 3. 9., 2014. 9. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Issuance of Designation Certificate) ① When the Director of a Regional Postal Service designates a Special Post Office, he/she shall issue a Special Post Office Designation Certificate in accordance with Attached Form No. 3 to the applicant. <Amended Dec. 31, 1998; Mar. 9, 2002; Sep. 2, 2014>

rows.source_ko: ②제1항의 지정을 하는 때에는 필요한 부관을 붙일 수 있다. <개정 1978. 5. 12.>
rows.text_en: ② When making a designation under Paragraph 1, necessary conditions may be attached. <Amended May 12, 1978>

rows.source_ko: 제6조(해지통보) 피지정인이 법 제3조제3항의 규정에 의하여 별정우체국의 지정을 해지하고자 하는 때에는 별지 제4호서식의 별정우체국지정해지통보서를 관할지방우정청장에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2014. 9. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Notice of Termination) If a designated person intends to terminate the designation of a special post office pursuant to the provisions of Article 3, Paragraph 3 of the Act , he/she shall submit a Notice of Termination of Designation of Special Post Office in the form of Attached Form No. 4 to the Director of the competent Regional Postal Service. <Amended Sep. 2, 2014>
[Wholly Amended Mar. 9, 2002]

rows.source_ko: 제7조(업무인수계획 수립) 제6조의 규정에 의하여 해지신고서를 받은 지방우정청장은 당해 별정우체국의 업무인수를 위한 계획을 수립하여야 한다. <개정 2014. 9. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Establishment of Business Takeover Plan) The Director of a Regional Postal Service who has received a notice of termination pursuant to the provisions of Article 6 shall establish a plan for the takeover of the business of the relevant Special Post Office. <Amended Sep. 2, 2014>
[Wholly Amended Mar. 9, 2002]

rows.source_ko: 제8조(지정의 취소사유보고) 지방우정청장은 법 제15조의 규정에 의한 별정우체국지정의 취소사유가 있다고 인정되는 때에는 그 지정의 취소후의 업무인수를 위한 계획서를 첨부하여 그 사유를 지체없이 우정사업본부장에게 보고하여야 한다. <개정 1982. 7. 3., 1998. 12. 31., 2002. 3. 9., 2014. 9. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Reporting of Grounds for Cancellation of Designation) When the Director of a Regional Postal Service recognizes that there are grounds for canceling the designation of a Special Post Office pursuant to Article 15 of the Act, he/she shall report such grounds to the Director of the Korea Post without delay, attaching a plan for the takeover of operations following the cancellation of the designation. <Amended July 3, 1982; December 31, 1998; March 9, 2002; September 2, 2014>

rows.source_ko: 제9조(지정승계의 신청) ①「별정우체국법 시행령」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제8조에 따라 별정우체국의 지정을 승계하려는 사람은 별지 제5호서식의 별정우체국지정승계신청서(전자문서로 된 신청서를 포함한다)에 다음 각 호의 서류(전자문서를 포함한다)를 첨부하여 관할지방우정청장에게 제출해야 한다. <개정 1993. 5. 1., 1998. 12. 31., 2002. 3. 9., 2004. 7. 6., 2005. 6. 20., 2006. 7. 19., 2009. 12. 31., 2014. 9. 2., 2025. 12. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Application for Succession of Designation) ① A person who intends to succeed to the designation of a Special Post Office pursuant to Article 8 of the Enforcement Decree of the Special Post Office Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) shall submit to the head of the competent Regional Postal Service Office an Application for Succession of Designation of a Special Post Office (including an application in the form of an electronic document) in Attached Form No. 5 , attaching the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs (including electronic documents). <Amended May 1, 1993; December 31, 1998; March 9, 2002; July 6, 2004; June 20, 2005; July 19, 2006; December 31, 2009; September 2, 2014; December 1, 2025>
1. Deleted <July 19, 2006>
2. Deleted <March 9, 2002>

rows.source_ko: 3. 「건강검진기본법」 제14조에 따라 지정된 검진기관에서 발급한 신체검사서 또는 국민건강보험공단이 「국민건강보험법」 제52조제2항제1호에 따른 일반건강검진 결과를 활용하여 신체검사를 대체할 목적으로 발급한 서류
rows.text_en: 3. A physical examination certificate issued by a medical examination institution designated pursuant to Article 14 of the Framework Act on Health Examinations, or a document issued by the National Health Insurance Service for the purpose of substituting a physical examination using the results of a general health examination pursuant to Article 52, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 1 of the National Health Insurance Act.

rows.source_ko: 4. 청사로 사용할 건물을 사용할 수 있는 권리를 증명하는 서류
rows.text_en: 4. Documents proving the right to use the building to be used as an office building
5. Letter of Guarantee
6. Deleted <July 19, 2006>

rows.source_ko: 7. 신원보증인의 주민등록증 등 공공기관이 발행한 본인 확인이 가능한 신분증 사본
rows.text_en: 7. A copy of the guarantor's identification card issued by a public institution that can verify identity, such as a Resident Registration Card.

rows.source_ko: ②제1항에 따라 별정우체국지정승계신청서를 제출받은 담당공무원은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 다음 각 호의 서류를 확인해야 한다. 다만, 신청인이 제1호에 따른 서류의 확인에 동의하지 않는 경우에는 이를 첨부하도록 해야 한다. <신설 2006. 7. 19., 2010. 6. 29., 2025. 12. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② The public official in charge who receives an application for succession of designation as a special post office pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall verify the documents set forth in each of the following subparagraphs through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act . However, if the applicant does not consent to the verification of the documents under Subparagraph 1, the applicant shall be required to attach them. <Newly added July 19, 2006; June 29, 2010; December 1, 2025>
1. Certificate of Family Relations Records
2. Certified copy of the real estate register (including the certified copy of the real estate register of the guarantor)

rows.source_ko: ③관할지방우정청장은 별정우체국의 지정승계를 승인하기 전에 지정승계 신청인에 대한 신원조회를 실시해야 한다. <신설 2002. 3. 9., 2006. 7. 19., 2014. 9. 2., 2025. 12. 1.>
rows.text_en: ③ The head of the competent Regional Postal Service shall conduct a background check on the applicant for designation succession before approving the designation succession of a Special Post Office. <Newly added Mar. 9, 2002; Jul. 19, 2006; Sep. 2, 2014; Dec. 1, 2025>

[Wholly Amended May 21, 1987]
[Title Amended December 1, 2025]

rows.source_ko: 제10조(준용규정) 제4조 및 제5조의 규정은 별정우체국의 지정승계에 이를 준용한다. <개정 2025. 12. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Applicable Provisions) The provisions of Articles 4 and 5 shall apply mutatis mutandis to the succession of designation of Special Post Offices. <Amended Dec. 1, 2025>
Chapter 2 Facilities

rows.source_ko: 제11조(시설등의 기준) 피지정인은 별표 1에 의한 별정우체국의 시설 및 비품을 갖추어야 한다. 다만, 청사시설의 기준면적과 구조등은 지역여건을 고려하여 지방우정청장과 협의하여 변경할 수 있다. <개정 2002. 3. 9., 2014. 9. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Standards for Facilities, etc.) The designated person shall be equipped with the facilities and equipment of a special post office as specified in Annex 1. However, the standard area and structure, etc. of the office building facilities may be changed in consultation with the Director of the Regional Postal Service, taking into consideration local conditions. <Amended Mar. 9, 2002; Sep. 2, 2014>
[Wholly Amended Dec. 31, 1998]

rows.source_ko: 제12조(시설 등 확인) 피지정인은 제11조의 규정에 의한 시설 및 비품을 완비하였을 때에는 관할지방우정청장에게 보고하여야 한다. 이 경우 지방우정청장은 이를 확인하여야 한다. <개정 2014. 9. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Verification of Facilities, etc.) When the designated person has completed the facilities and equipment pursuant to the provisions of Article 11, he/she shall report to the competent Regional Post Office Director. In this case, the Regional Post Office Director shall verify such facilities and equipment. <Amended Sep. 2, 2014>
[Wholly Amended Mar. 9, 2002]
Article 13 Deleted <December 31, 1998>
Article 14 Deleted <December 31, 1998>
Article 15 Deleted <December 31, 1998>
Chapter 3 Payment of Expenses, etc.

rows.source_ko: 제16조(사무비) ①지방우정청장은 영 제73조제1항제2호에 따라 우정사업본부장이 정하는 지급기준에 따라 별정우체국의 원활한 업무운영을 위하여 예산의 범위안에서 기본운영비를 지급한다. 기본운영비는 당해 우체국의 시설, 수입, 지출 및 업무실적을 참작하여 계산한다. <개정 1998. 12. 31., 2002. 3. 9., 2005. 6. 20., 2014. 9. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 16 (Administrative Expenses) ① The Director of a Regional Postal Service shall pay basic operating expenses within the limits of the budget for the smooth operation of special post offices , in accordance with the payment standards determined by the Director of Korea Post pursuant to Article 73 , Paragraph 1 , Subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree. Basic operating expenses shall be calculated by taking into account the facilities, revenue, expenditure, and operational performance of the relevant post office. <Amended Dec. 31, 1998; Mar. 9, 2002; Jun. 20, 2005; Sep. 2, 2014>

rows.source_ko: ②지방우정청장은 예산의 범위안에서 「산업안전보건법」에 의한 직원의 건강진단에 소요되는 비용과 「국민건강보험법」 및 「산업재해보상보험법」에서 정한 보험료의 일부를 지급할 수 있다. <신설 1980. 12. 31., 1987. 5. 21., 1998. 12. 31., 2002. 3. 9., 2005. 6. 20., 2014. 9. 2.>
rows.text_en: ② The Director of the Regional Post Office may, within the limits of the budget, pay the costs incurred for health examinations of employees pursuant to the Occupational Safety and Health Act and a portion of the insurance premiums prescribed by the National Health Insurance Act and the Industrial Accident Compensation Insurance Act . <Newly added Dec. 31, 1980; May 21, 1987; Dec. 31, 1998; Mar. 9, 2002; Jun. 20, 2005; Sep. 2, 2014>

rows.source_ko: ③지방우정청장은 제1항의 규정에 의한 기본운영비외에 예산의 범위안에서 업무보조원을 사용함에 필요한 경비를 사무보조비로 지급할 수 있다. <개정 1984. 1. 11., 1987. 5. 21., 1993. 5. 1., 1998. 12. 31., 2002. 3. 9., 2005. 6. 20., 2014. 9. 2.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Director of a Regional Post Office may, within the limits of the budget, pay administrative support expenses necessary for the use of administrative assistants in addition to the basic operating expenses under Paragraph 1. <Amended Jan. 11, 1984; May 21, 1987; May 1, 1993; December 31, 1998; March 9, 2002; June 20, 2005; September 2, 2014>

rows.source_ko: 제17조(업무취급수수료) 지방우정청장은 별정우체국에서 취급한 업무에 대하여 취급수수료를 지급하되, 지급대상업무의 종류 및 지급액은 우정사업본부장이 이를 정하여 고시한다. <개정 1998. 12. 31., 2002. 3. 9., 2014. 9. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 17 (Handling Fees) The Director of a Regional Postal Service shall pay handling fees for services handled by designated post offices; provided that the Director of the Korea Post determines and announces the types of services eligible for payment and the amounts to be paid . <Amended Dec. 31, 1998; Mar. 9, 2002; Sep. 2, 2014>
[Wholly Amended Aug. 11, 1988]

rows.source_ko: 제18조(제복의 지급) 지방우정청장은 별정우체국장이 채용한 사무원 및 집배원에 대하여 우정사업본부장이 정하는 바에 따라 제복을 지급한다. <개정 1993. 5. 1., 1998. 12. 31., 2002. 3. 9., 2014. 9. 2., 2022. 1. 4.>
rows.text_en: Article 18 (Provision of Uniforms) The Director of a Regional Postal Service shall provide uniforms to clerks and mail carriers employed by the Director of a Special Post Office, as determined by the Director of the Korea Post. <Amended May 1, 1993; December 31, 1998; March 9, 2002; September 2, 2014; January 4, 2022>

[Wholly Amended July 3, 1982]
[Title Amended Jan. 4, 2022]

rows.source_ko: 제19조(물품의 교부) ①지방우정청장은 별표 2에서 정하는 물품의 전부 또는 일부를 법 제13조의 규정에 의하여 별정우체국에 교부할 수 있다. <개정 1998. 12. 31., 2002. 3. 9., 2014. 9. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 19 (Delivery of Goods) ① The Director of a Regional Postal Service may deliver all or part of the goods specified in Annex 2 to a Special Post Office pursuant to the provisions of Article 13 of the Act . <Amended Dec. 31, 1998; Mar. 9, 2002; Sep. 2, 2014>

rows.source_ko: ②별정우체국장은 제1항의 규정에 의하여 교부된 물품을 타인에게 교부 또는 대여할 수 없다.
rows.text_en: ② The head of a special post office shall not deliver or lend items issued pursuant to the provisions of Paragraph 1 to another person.
[Wholly Amended May 21, 1987]
Chapter 4 Deleted <December 31, 2009>

rows.source_ko: 제20조(규제의 재검토) 과학기술정보통신부장관은 다음 각 호의 사항에 대하여 다음 각 호의 기준일을 기준으로 3년마다(매 3년이 되는 해의 기준일과 같은 날 전까지를 말한다) 그 타당성을 검토하여 개선 등의 조치를 하여야 한다. <개정 2017. 7. 26.>
rows.text_en: Article 20 (Review of Regulations) The Minister of Science and ICT shall review the validity of the matters set forth in each of the following subparagraphs every three years based on the reference dates specified in each of the following subparagraphs (meaning the period prior to the same date as the reference date of the year marking every third year) and take measures such as improvements. <Amended July 26, 2017>
1. Application for designation as a Special Post Office pursuant to Article 2 : January 1, 2014

rows.source_ko: 2. 제3조에 따른 별정우체국 신청인 등의 자산: 2014년 1월 1일
rows.text_en: 2. Assets of applicants for a special post office pursuant to Article 3 : January 1, 2014

rows.text_en: ③ (Transitional measures concerning facility standards) Notwithstanding the amended provisions of Article 11, office building facilities already possessed by the designated person at the time of the enforcement of this rule or office building facilities under construction with permission shall be governed by the former provisions.

rows.text_en: Article 2 (Applicability to Applications for Designation as Special Post Office)  The amended provisions of Article 2, Paragraph 1 and Form No. 1 shall apply from the time an application for the designation of a special post office is made after the enforcement of this Rule.

rows.text_en: Article 3 (Applicability to Applications for Succession of Designation of Special Post Offices)  The amended provisions of Article 9, Paragraph 1 and Form No. 5 shall apply from the time an application for the succession of designation of a special post office is made after the enforcement of this Rule.
